description: Fixture job postings for offline matching. Mix of strong, medium, and irrelevant fits against the fixture Master CV (payments / distributed systems / fraud / Python / Go).

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Payments
jobs.description: Own our payment settlement pipeline. You will build idempotent, sharded workers over a Kafka event log, in Go and Python on PostgreSQL, and drive reliability with distributed tracing and observability. Payments or fintech background strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Fraud Detection
jobs.description: Build realtime fraud scoring on a streaming platform. Compute velocity features with Flink over Kafka, serve them from a low-latency feature store, and backtest models against historical fraud. Python and gRPC experience valued.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Payments Ledger
jobs.description: Work on a high-volume settlement ledger in Go backed by PostgreSQL. Guarantee exactly-once payouts with idempotency keys and a replayable log. Care about correctness and merchant payout reliability.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: Scale our analytics API. Add read-through caching and query-planner hints, move heavy aggregations to a columnar store, and keep p99 latency low under peak reporting load. Distributed systems and gRPC a plus.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Own reliability across services. Kubernetes, distributed tracing, incident response, and observability. Reduce mean time to resolution and improve on-call quality.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Build product features end to end with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind on the frontend and a Node backend. Ship polished UI and delightful user experiences.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Lead brand campaigns, manage social channels, run SEO and email marketing, and grow our audience. Creative storytelling and analytics-informed campaign optimization.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Design intuitive product flows in Figma, run usability research, and craft a cohesive design system. Partner with engineering on delightful, accessible experiences.

jobs.title: Junior Frontend Developer
jobs.description: Entry-level role building web pages with HTML, CSS, and a bit of JavaScript. Learn from senior developers and grow your frontend skills.

jobs.title: Distributed Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Design fault-tolerant distributed systems with Kafka streaming, sharding, and replayable event logs. Strong Go and Python skills; care deeply about throughput and correctness.
